t: You're looking for the Tulip, though you won't find it, because it was never built. It was a proposed 305-metre observation tower for 20 Bury Street in the City of London. The idea came from the Safra Group, whose family owns the neighbouring Gherkin. Joseph Safra, the Brazilian banker who ran the group, was Brazil's richest man and the richest banker in the world. The proposal was rejected on the 11th of November 2021, so the Gherkin still stands without its tall neighbour.
